messages:
docs-jo: heads-up: API ref for PUT /v1/routes/{route_id} has several mismatches. request example uses `user_id` (int) but runtime expects `user` (string). also `metadata` shown as array of pairs in examples but server accepts a map/object. docs show query param `expand=true` but runtime supports `include=details`.
eng-aria: thanks, that slipped through when we switched to the new routing model. server now normalizes user to a string (uuid or email) and metadata is JSON object. `include` is the canonical query param.
docs-jo: can you paste a minimal curl and a current JSON response so I update examples? want to include both legacy and current shapes in the migration note.
eng-aria: sure:
```
curl -i -X PUT \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user":"user:alice@example.com","metadata":{"env":"prod"}}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/route-123?include=details
```
current response:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "id": "route-123",
  "user": "user:alice@example.com",
  "metadata": {"env":"prod"},
  "details": {"throughput": 120}
}
```
sdk-sam: our generated Go snippet still marshals `user_id` as int and expects metadata as [][2]string. we'll break. i'll update SDK generators after docs PR. please mark the migration note clearly.
docs-jo: plan: open small docs PR to change request example body -> `user` string, metadata -> object, query examples -> `include=details`. add migration section titled "Field and query param changes" with legacy examples for one release and a note: "SDKs have been updated to accept both shapes during transition." will also add a link to RFC-3087.
pm-eli: add a changelog link and tag the customers mailing list; some customers used numeric user ids in integrations.
ci-bot: docs lint: example request schema missing `type` annotations for metadata (warning).
docs-jo: will add schema snippet and show both legacy and new example under separate headings so search/grep finds both.
eng-aria: i'll also run a quick grep across endpoints to catch any other `user_id`/`user` mismatches and follow up if found.
sdk-sam: once docs PR merges i'll push a tiny SDK patch that accepts int or string for user and maps list-of-pairs -> object for metadata, then remove compatibility shim in next major.
deploy-bot: PR #6219 (docs): routes PUT examples updated  awaiting review :eyes:
docs-jo: pinging @eng-aria @sdk-sam for quick review. small but high impact change. thanks!"
